steps.en: Pull the Collector image and run it with the OTLP ports open: 4317 for gRPC, 4318 for HTTP
steps.zh: 拉取并启动 Collector，开放 OTLP 端口 4317 和 4318

steps.en: Declare receivers, processors and exporters in YAML, then wire them into per-signal pipelines
steps.zh: 在 YAML 里声明接收器、处理器、导出器，再按信号类型连成管线

steps.en: Point your apps' OpenTelemetry SDKs at the Collector instead of at a vendor
steps.zh: 让应用的 OTel SDK 改发给 Collector，不再直连厂商

steps.en: Receives traces, metrics and logs and converts them into one internal data model
steps.zh: 接收链路、指标和日志，统一转换成一种内部数据格式

steps.en: Batches, filters, samples and enriches the data in flight
steps.zh: 在传输途中批量打包、过滤、采样、补充元数据

steps.en: Sends each signal to one or more backends, queueing and retrying on failure
steps.zh: 把每类信号发往一个或多个后端，失败时排队重试

value.en: Changing or adding a backend is a YAML edit in one place — your apps keep emitting OTLP and are never re-instrumented
value.zh: 换后端或加后端只改一处 YAML——应用照旧发 OTLP，不用重新埋点

sources: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry.io/blob/main/content/en/docs/collector/quick-start.md (docker pull otel/opentelemetry-collector; docker run opening 4317 gRPC and 4318 HTTP)
https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/blob/main/README.md (receive, process and export telemetry; vendor-agnostic; single codebase for traces, metrics and logs)
